question: What are the underlying mechanics of the health and armor system in Ev.io?
answer: The health and armor system in Ev.io is designed to add depth to the gameplay. Health represents your character's vitality, while armor provides additional protection against incoming damage. When you take damage, armor absorbs a portion of it before your health is affected. For example, if you have 100 health and 50 armor, and you take 60 damage, your armor will absorb 50, leaving you with 90 health. Health can be restored using health packs found throughout the map, while armor must be replenished by picking up armor items.
